tools.name: account-profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user profile including name, email, avatar, and subscription plan.

tools.name: account-usage
tools.description: Get credit usage, remaining balance, plan limits, storage quota (used/limit/remaining), and billing cycle info for the authenticated account.

tools.name: ai-apply-theme
tools.description: Apply visual themes to an existing mockup (e.g. "christmas", "cyberpunk", "minimalist"). Costs credits.

tools.name: ai-change-object
tools.description: Replace or modify an object in an existing mockup image. Costs credits. Pass the image and describe what to change.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the image to modify.

base64.description: Base64 of the image to modify.

newObject.description: Description of what to replace/change (e.g. "replace the coffee cup with a wine glass").

tools.name: ai-describe-image
tools.description: Analyze an image and return a detailed text description. Provide either a URL or base64-encoded data. Free, no credit cost.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the image to analyze.

base64.description: Base64-encoded image data (include data URI prefix or raw base64).

tools.name: ai-extract-colors
tools.description: Extract a color palette from any image. Returns hex values, names, roles, and frequency. Free (no credits).

mimeType.description: MIME type if using base64 (e.g. image/png).

tools.name: ai-generate-image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt. No brand injection, no project saving — just prompt → image. For placing existing designs in scenes, use mockup-generate instead. Costs credits.

prompt.description: Full image description — style, composition, colors, lighting, mood.

model.description: gpt-image-2=best, gemini=fast, seedream=photorealistic (requires your own BytePlus API key via Settings → BYOK).

referenceImages.description: Reference URLs or base64 to guide style. Use upload-image for local files.

tools.name: ai-generate-naming
tools.description: Generate brand/product name ideas from a brief. Optionally uses brand guideline for tone consistency. Costs credits.

brief.description: Description of what needs naming (e.g. "eco-friendly water bottle brand targeting millennials").

style.description: Naming style: minimal, playful, corporate, abstract, etc.

brandGuidelineId.description: Brand guideline ID for tone/voice consistency.

seen.description: Names already shown in prior rounds — never repeated.

liked.description: Names the user liked so far.

superliked.description: Names the user superliked — treated as the north star for this round.

rejected.description: Names the user rejected — their pattern is avoided.

tasteReading.description: Qualitative taste-pattern reading from a prior round (naming-insight).

territories.description: Symbolic territories to distribute this round across.

tools.name: ai-improve-prompt
tools.description: Enhance and refine a text prompt using AI to produce better generation results. Free, no credit cost.

tools.name: ai-suggest-prompt-variations
tools.description: Generate multiple creative variations of a prompt. Free (cached). Use to give users options before spending credits on generation.

prompt.description: Original prompt to create variations of.

tools.name: api-key-create
tools.description: Create a new Visant API key (visant_sk_xxx). Requires either an active API key (Bearer token) OR a JWT from auth-login/auth-register. The raw key is shown only once — save it immediately.

name.description: A label for this key, e.g. "Claude.ai MCP" or "Production".

jwt.description: JWT token from auth-login or auth-register (if you have no API key yet).

tools.name: api-key-list
tools.description: List all API keys for the authenticated user. Shows prefix, name, scopes, last used, and expiry — but not the raw key value.

tools.name: auth-login
tools.description: Sign in to an existing Visant Labs account. Returns a JWT token. Use api-key-create (passing this token) to generate a visant_sk_xxx API key for persistent MCP/API access.

tools.name: auth-register
tools.description: Create a new Visant Labs account. Returns a JWT token and user info. After registering, use api-key-create (passing the JWT) to generate a visant_sk_xxx API key for MCP/API access.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-compare-versions
tools.description: Compare two versions of a brand guideline to see what changed (colors added, typography modified, strategy updated, etc.).

tools.name: brand-guidelines-compile
tools.description: Compile a brand guideline into design tokens — returns four ready-to-use files: CSS custom properties, a Tailwind theme extension, React/TS tokens, and SCSS variables. Use for design-to-code workflows.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-compliance-check
tools.description: Validate a brand's color palette for WCAG contrast and internal consistency. Returns a scored report with violations. (For strategy ↔ visual ↔ voice coherence, use brand-guidelines-health-check instead.)

tools.name: brand-guidelines-create
tools.description: Create a new brand guideline. Provide at minimum an identity.name. All other sections (colors, typography, guidelines, strategy, tokens) are optional and can be added now or via brand-guidelines-update later.

role.description: e.g. primary, secondary, background, text, accent

manifesto.description: Brand manifesto: plain text, or the provocation/tension/promise arc.

copyExamples.description: Real copy the brand has shipped, kept verbatim as few-shot material for generation. Unlike voiceValues (which describe the tone) these are the artifacts to imitate.

type.description: What kind of copy this is.

coreMessage.description: Core brand message: what the product is, how it differs, emotional connection.

graphicSystem.description: Graphic system rules: patterns, grafisms, image guidelines, editorial grid.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a brand guideline. This cannot be undone. Confirm with the user before calling.

id.description: The brand guideline ID to delete.

confirm.description: Must be true. Prevents accidental deletion.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-delete-logo
tools.description: Delete a logo from a brand guideline by its logo ID.

logoId.description: Logo ID to delete (from the logos array).

tools.name: brand-guidelines-delete-media
tools.description: Delete a media asset from a brand guideline by its media ID.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate a brand guideline, creating an independent copy with "(copy)" appended to the name. Useful for creating variants or testing changes without affecting the original.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-export
tools.description: Export a brand guideline as a portable JSON document for backup or migration — internal fields (ownership, view counts, sync state) are stripped. For working with a brand in-session, prefer brand-guidelines-get (supports section filtering and prompt format).

tools.name: brand-guidelines-figma-link
tools.description: Link or unlink a Figma file to a brand guideline. Once linked, figma-sync can pull design tokens automatically.

fileId.description: Figma file ID to link. Omit to unlink.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-figma-preview
tools.description: Dry-run for brand-guidelines-figma-sync: reports what the linked Figma file actually contains (color variables, text styles, components) and recommends which import path pays — "variables" when the file has a real token system, "text" when it does not (e.g. variables named after their own hex values). Reads only; changes nothing.

id.description: Brand guideline ID (must already have a linked Figma file).

tools.name: brand-guidelines-figma-sync
tools.description: Sync brand guideline with a Figma file. Imports colors, typography, and design tokens from Figma VARIABLES and styles. Call brand-guidelines-figma-preview FIRST: most real files have no variable system, and on those this sync imports almost nothing — the preview says which path actually pays before you spend the call. Requires Figma token configured in user settings.

includeVariables.description: Import Figma variables as design tokens.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-get
tools.description: Get a brand guideline by ID. Use "sections" to fetch only what you need (e.g. ["colors","typography"] for visual tasks). Presets: "visual" (colors/typo/tokens), "copy" (voice/strategy), "minimal" (identity/colors/typo), "imageGen", "full". Omit sections for full context.

sections.description: Which brand sections to include. Pass an array of specific sections, or a preset name: "visual", "copy", "minimal", "imageGen", "full". Omit for full context.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-health-check
tools.description: Audit a brand guideline for completeness. Returns which sections are filled, which are missing, and suggestions for improvement.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-ingest
tools.description: Extract brand data (colors, typography, voice, strategy) from a URL or raw text and MERGE it into an existing brand guideline. Useful for bootstrapping a guideline from a website, landing page, or brand document. Returns the extracted values. Pass preview=true to see what would be extracted WITHOUT saving (dry run), then re-run without preview to commit.

id.description: Brand guideline ID to merge extracted data into.

source.description: "url" to scrape a webpage; "text" to extract from raw text/markdown.

text.description: Raw text or markdown to extract from (required when source=text).

preview.description: Dry run: return the extraction without saving. Re-run without preview to merge.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-invite
tools.description: Create an invite link for a brand guideline. The recipient gets a connect page where they can accept the invite, associate the brand to their account, and get one-click deep links to connect their AI tool (Cursor, VS Code, Claude, ChatGPT). Perfect for onboarding clients.

role.description: Access level: viewer (read-only) or editor (can modify).

label.description: Display label for the invite (e.g. "YSA — Brand Kit"). Auto-generated if omitted.

expiresInDays.description: Days until the invite expires. No expiration if omitted.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-knowledge-list
tools.description: List all knowledge documents (PDFs, brand docs) attached to a brand guideline.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-list
tools.description: List brand guidelines (identity vaults) owned by the authenticated user. Supports pagination and name search — use "search" to find a brand by name instead of listing every one.

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

search.description: Filter by brand name (case-insensitive, partial match).

tools.name: brand-guidelines-logo-rules
tools.description: Derive logo usage rules from the logo file itself: clear space, minimum reproduction size (screen + print), and which brand colors it may sit on (WCAG contrast). Deterministic measurement, not an AI guess. Runs automatically on upload — call this to backfill an older logo or to switch the clear-space module.

logoId.description: Logo ID to measure (from the logos array).

module.description: Which part of the logo defines one unit of clear space. The single conventional choice in this calculation.

safety.description: Multiplier on the physical minimum size. 1 = the bare legibility floor.

persist.description: Write the rules onto the logo. False returns them without saving.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-media-commit
tools.description: Register assets already uploaded via brand-guidelines-media-upload-urls into the brand media kit. Fingerprints each file server-side, so duplicates (including files already present as logos) are reported and skipped. Returns added, duplicates, failed and the new completeness score.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-media-upload-urls
tools.description: Mint direct-to-storage upload URLs for a batch of local files (max 50). Returns one presignedUrl per file; PUT each file to its URL (e.g. curl -X PUT --data-binary @file -H "Content-Type: <contentType>"), then call brand-guidelines-media-commit with the mediaIds. Use this for local files: the bytes never pass through the conversation.

filename.description: Original file name — used to infer the content type.

size.description: File size in bytes. Used to check the storage quota before uploading.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-public
tools.description: Get a public brand guideline by its slug. No authentication required.

slug.description: The public slug of the brand guideline.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-restore-version
tools.description: Restore a brand guideline to a previous version. The current state is preserved as a version before restoring.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-share
tools.description: Generate a public read-only link for a brand guideline. Once shared, anyone with the link can view colors, typography, logos, and brand strategy — without authentication. Returns the public URL.

disable.description: Pass true to revoke public access instead of enabling it.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-update
tools.description: Patch one or more sections of an existing brand guideline. Only the fields you provide are updated — others remain unchanged. Use this to iteratively build or refine a guideline section by section.

id.description: The brand guideline ID to update.

role.description: e.g. primary, secondary, background, text, accent, cta

person.description: Point of view for brand copy.

casingRules.description: Capitalization rules, e.g. "Always capitalize product name"

manifesto.description: Brand manifesto: plain text, or the provocation/tension/promise arc.

copyExamples.description: Real copy the brand has shipped, kept verbatim as few-shot material for generation. Unlike voiceValues (which describe the tone) these are the artifacts to imitate.

type.description: What kind of copy this is.

coreMessage.description: Core brand message: what the product is, how it differs, emotional connection.

graphicSystem.description: Graphic system rules: patterns, grafisms, image guidelines, editorial grid.

shadows.description: Named shadow tokens, e.g. { "sm": { x:0, y:1, blur:2, ... } }

components.description: Component-level design tokens as key-value pairs.

motion.description: Motion/animation design tokens. Shallow-merged with existing.

colorThemes.description: Replaces the full color themes array.

activeSections.description: Which guideline sections are visible/active in the UI.

orderedBlocks.description: Custom ordering of guideline blocks in the UI.

tools.name: brand-guidelines-upload-logo
tools.description: Upload a logo to a brand guideline. Accepts base64-encoded image data or a public URL. Returns the uploaded logo with its URL and ID.

url.description: Public URL of the logo image (alternative to base64 data).

tools.name: brand-guidelines-upload-media
tools.description: Upload ONE media asset (image or PDF) to a brand guideline media kit, as base64 data or a public URL. For more than 2 files, or files above ~500 KB, use brand-guidelines-media-upload-urls instead — base64 puts the whole file through the conversation.

url.description: Public URL of the media asset (alternative to base64 data).

label.description: Label for this media asset, e.g. "Brand Presentation", "Campaign Photo".

tools.name: brand-guidelines-versions
tools.description: List the version history of a brand guideline — shows what changed and when. Useful for auditing edits or restoring a previous state. Returns versions in reverse chronological order.

tools.name: brand-render-preset
tools.description: Render a web preset to a PNG image on the brand — fully headless, no Figma. The server resolves colors, fonts, and REAL assets (logo by contrast, photo by semantic relevance), optionally applies a Visant image effect (halftone/riso/texture) to the photo, and returns a ready image URL. You supply only the template id, the text content, and an optional brief. This is the CLIENT/web path (vs figma-preset-fill, which targets the Figma plugin).

brief.description: Short brief/vibe to semantically pick the photo from brand media.

effect.description: Optional Visant image effect applied to the photo.

tools.name: branding-delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a branding project by ID. Cannot be undone — confirm with the user first.

tools.name: branding-generate
tools.description: Generate brand identity elements from a text prompt. Use step="full" for complete generation or target a specific step for iterative refinement. Costs credits.

prompt.description: Brand brief (e.g. "modern tech startup called Acme, targets developers, dark aesthetic").

step.description: Generation step. RECOMMENDED: use "visant-full" for the complete Metodologia Visant pipeline (10 steps, higher quality). Legacy: "full" runs the older single-pass pipeline. For iterative refinement, use individual "visant-*" steps in order and pass previousData between calls.

previousData.description: Output from a previous step to use as context for the next step. Pass the result of the previous branding-generate call here.

brandGuidelineId.description: Existing brand guideline ID to use as context/reference.

tools.name: branding-get
tools.description: Get a branding project by ID, including logo, colors, typography, and brand assets.

tools.name: branding-list
tools.description: List branding projects owned by the authenticated user. Supports pagination and name search.

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

search.description: Filter by project name (case-insensitive, partial match).

tools.name: branding-save
tools.description: Create or update a branding project. If projectId is provided and the project exists, it updates it; otherwise creates a new one. Returns the saved project.

prompt.description: Brand brief or description used to generate the project.

data.description: Branding project data (colors, typography, logos, etc.).

projectId.description: Existing project ID to update. Omit to create a new project.

tools.name: budget-create
tools.description: Create a new budget document with client and project details. Returns the created budget.

projectDescription.description: Brief description of the project scope.

brandName.description: Brand name if different from client name.

tools.name: budget-delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a budget project by ID. Cannot be undone — confirm with the user first.

tools.name: budget-duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate an existing budget project. Returns the new project.

tools.name: budget-get
tools.description: Get a budget document by ID, including line items, totals, and client info.

tools.name: budget-list
tools.description: List budget documents created by the authenticated user. Supports pagination and search by budget or client name.

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

search.description: Filter by budget or client name (case-insensitive, partial match).

tools.name: budget-update
tools.description: Update an existing budget project by ID. Accepts any subset of budget fields — only provided fields are modified.

data.description: Full budget data object (replaces existing data field).

tools.name: campaign-generate
tools.description: Start a batch ad campaign generation. Returns a jobId for polling. Creates multiple mockup variations across formats (square, story, banner, portrait). Costs credits per image.

productImageUrl.description: Public URL of the product/design image.

brandGuidelineId.description: Brand guideline ID for brand-consistent ad copy and styling.

brief.description: Campaign brief: target audience, goal, tone (e.g. "launch campaign for Gen Z, playful tone").

count.description: Number of ad variations to generate.

tools.name: campaign-get
tools.description: Get a single persisted campaign by id, including its full results (generated ad image URLs per format/angle).

id.description: Campaign id returned by campaign-generate or campaign-list.

tools.name: campaign-list
tools.description: List persisted campaigns owned by the authenticated user. Campaigns survive the 2h job TTL. Filter by brandGuidelineId to see all campaigns for one brand.

brandId.description: Brand guideline ID to filter campaigns by (brand cockpit view).

tools.name: campaign-status
tools.description: Poll a batch campaign job for progress. Returns status (planning/generating/done/error) and completed results with image URLs.

tools.name: canvas-create
tools.description: Create a new empty canvas (whiteboard) project.

tools.name: canvas-delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a canvas project by ID. Cannot be undone — confirm with the user first.

tools.name: canvas-get
tools.description: Get a canvas project by ID, including elements, collaborators, and metadata.

tools.name: canvas-list
tools.description: List canvas (whiteboard) projects owned by the authenticated user. Supports pagination and name search.

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

search.description: Filter by canvas name (case-insensitive, partial match).

tools.name: canvas-list-projects
tools.description: List canvas projects for the authenticated user with node type summary.

tools.name: canvas-parse-csv
tools.description: Parse a CSV string and return the rows as an array of objects. Use this to preview what a DataNode will produce from a CSV file before uploading it to the canvas.

csv.description: Raw CSV text with a header row.

preview_rows.description: Number of rows to return in the preview (1-50).

tools.name: canvas-resolve-variables
tools.description: Given a prompt string and a variables map (key→value pairs), resolve all {{placeholder}} tokens and return the final prompt. Useful for previewing what a VariablesNode or DataNode will produce before generation.

variables.description: Map of variable name to value, e.g. {"brand":"Nike","color":"red"}.

tools.name: canvas-share
tools.description: Share a canvas project with other users. Generates a shareId and sets collaborative mode. Accepts user emails or user IDs for canEdit/canView lists.

canEdit.description: List of user emails or IDs who can edit.

canView.description: List of user emails or IDs who can view.

tools.name: canvas-update
tools.description: Update a canvas project by ID. Provide any combination of name, nodes, edges, drawings, or linkedGuidelineId. Only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: community-my-presets
tools.description: List your own community presets (approved and pending). Requires auth.

tools.name: community-preset-create
tools.description: Create a new community preset. Requires auth. The preset will be publicly visible once approved.

tools.name: community-preset-delete
tools.description: Delete your own community preset permanently. Requires auth.

tools.name: community-preset-get
tools.description: Get a single community preset by ID. No auth required.

tools.name: community-preset-like
tools.description: Toggle like/unlike on a community preset. Returns updated like count. Requires auth.

tools.name: community-preset-update
tools.description: Update your own community preset. Only provided fields are changed. Requires auth.

tools.name: community-presets
tools.description: Browse approved community presets. Filter by category or search by keyword. No auth required.

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

search.description: Search presets by name or tags.

tools.name: community-profiles
tools.description: Browse public community creator profiles. No auth required.

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

tools.name: creative-full
tools.description: Full creative pipeline in one call. Generates layout plan → background image → renders to PNG → saves project. Returns imageUrl, projectId, plan, and per-step credits. Use this instead of chaining creative-generate + mockup-generate + creative-render manually.

prompt.description: Creative brief describing the desired visual.

brandGuidelineId.description: Brand guideline ID to inject brand context.

autoSave.description: Persist result as a creative project.

tools.name: creative-generate
tools.description: Generate a structured marketing creative layout (background, text layers, logo, shapes) from a prompt. Optionally inject brand guideline context. Returns a layered creative plan ready for the Creative Studio. Costs credits.

prompt.description: Creative brief (e.g. "Summer sale banner for a surf brand, bold and energetic").

brandGuidelineId.description: Brand guideline ID to inject colors, fonts, and voice into the creative.

tools.name: creative-projects-create
tools.description: Save a creative project to the database. Requires prompt, format, and layers (from creative-generate). Optionally attach a brand guideline and background/thumbnail URLs.

prompt.description: Creative brief used to generate this project.

name.description: Project display name. Defaults to "Untitled Creative".

campaignId.description: Campaign ID to link this creative to (groups creatives under a campaign).

tools.name: creative-projects-delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a creative project by ID. Cannot be undone — confirm with the user first.

tools.name: creative-projects-get
tools.description: Get a creative project by ID, including all layers, background, and generated assets.

tools.name: creative-projects-list
tools.description: List creative studio projects owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: creative-projects-update
tools.description: Update an existing creative project (partial update). All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: creative-render
tools.description: Render a creative plan (from creative-generate) into a PNG image server-side. Pass the plan JSON and the pre-generated background image URL. Returns imageUrl (public R2 URL). Use this to close the generate→image loop without a browser: generate plan, render, inspect image with vision, adjust, re-render.

backgroundImageUrl.description: Pre-generated background image URL (from mockup-generate or any image URL).

accentColor.description: Hex color for <accent> words in text layers. Defaults to white.

tools.name: delete-studio3d-scene
tools.description: Delete a saved 3D Studio scene.

tools.name: document-extract
tools.description: Extract content from a PDF using a 2-phase pipeline: algorithmic (exact colors, fonts, embedded images) then Gemini semantic analysis (strategy, personas, voice, dos/donts, asset classification). Returns markdownText (structured, page-separated — ideal for RAG chunking) plus brand tokens. Accepts either pdf_base64 (base64-encoded PDF content, preferred for remote MCP usage) or pdf_path (server-side path). IMPORTANT: before calling, ask the user whether they want the result saved to disk as a .md file or returned inline.

pdf_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF content. Preferred when calling from a remote agent — read the file locally and encode it. Mutually exclusive with pdf_path.

pdf_filename.description: Original filename (e.g. "brand.pdf"). Required when using pdf_base64 with output="disk" so the .md file can be named correctly.

pdf_path.description: Absolute server-side path to a PDF. Only use when the file is on the same machine as the MCP server.

output.description: "disk" — saves a .md file alongside the PDF (pdf_path) or in the current directory (pdf_base64) and returns { saved_to, characters, preview }. "inline" — returns the full markdownText in the response (no file written).

include_brand_tokens.description: Include colors, typography, strategy, and asset classifications. Default: true.

tools.name: figma-extract-text
tools.description: Extract all text from a Figma file as markdown, in canvas reading order and grouped by page and frame. This is the raw material for a brand guideline: pipe the returned markdown straight into brand-guidelines-ingest (source=text). Works on any file your Figma token can read — no plugin and no open tab required. Requires a Figma token in user settings.

fileId.description: Figma file key, or a full figma.com/design/... URL (either works).

tools.name: figma-preset-fill
tools.description: Build a complete, deterministic FILL_TEMPLATE operation for the Visant Figma plugin. The server resolves the brand's REAL colors (variable modes) AND images (logos by variant/contrast, photos by semantic relevance) into a [Template]'s #slots. You supply only the brand, the template name, the text content, and an optional brief — never URLs or geometry. Run the returned operation in the Visant Figma plugin to produce an on-brand design with zero hallucinated layout.

templateName.description: The [Template] frame name (e.g. "Post/Launch"). Provide this or templateNodeId.

templateNodeId.description: The [Template] frame node id (alternative to templateName).

text.description: Text slot content keyed by slot id, e.g. { "h1": "...", "infos": ["a","b"] }.

imageSlots.description: Image slots to resolve (default: logo, photo1, photo2, icon). variant picks a logo variant (e.g. "dark").

brief.description: Short brief/vibe used to semantically pick the best photo from the brand media.

clone.description: Fill a clone (default true) so the master template stays pristine.

tools.name: figma-templates-list
tools.description: List the [Template] presets in a brand's Figma file (or a given fileKey), with each template's name, aspect, and #slots (id, type text/image, optional, variant). Use this to discover what exists and what to fill BEFORE calling figma-preset-fill. Read-only.

fileKey.description: Figma file key (defaults to the brand's linked file).

tools.name: image-extract-url
tools.description: Extract high-resolution images from any public URL (Behance, Pinterest, Dribbble, portfolios, blogs). Returns a list of image URLs with metadata. Supports lazy-loaded images, srcset, and background images.

url.description: The public URL to extract images from (e.g. Behance gallery, portfolio page).

limit.description: Maximum number of images to return (default 80).

tools.name: images-to-pdf
tools.description: Create a multi-page PDF from images. Each image becomes one page sized to fit the image dimensions. Accepts PNG and JPEG base64-encoded images.

images.description: Array of base64-encoded images (PNG or JPEG)

tools.name: mockup-delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a mockup by ID. Cannot be undone — confirm with the user first.

tools.name: mockup-generate

prompt.description: Scene/environment ONLY — surface material, lighting, camera angle, wear/texture, background color. NEVER describe the design content (text, logo, layout) here — the AI will hallucinate it. Pass the actual design via referenceImages or brandGuidelineId instead.

brandGuidelineId.description: Brand guideline ID. Auto-injects logo, colors, typography into generation. Alternative to referenceImages — use one or the other.

model.description: gpt-image-2=best quality (recommended), gemini=fast/creative, seedream=photorealistic (requires your own BytePlus API key via Settings → BYOK).

provider.description: Provider override. Inferred from model by default.

designType.description: Hint: business-card, social-media, packaging, apparel, signage, sticker, etc.

baseImageUrl.description: Base image for img2img transformation (rare). For placing a design in a scene, use referenceImages instead.

referenceImages.description: URLs of the design/artwork to place in the scene (e.g. logo, poster, card). Get URLs via upload-image tool first. Also accepts base64 data URIs. This is NOT a preset ID — it must be an image URL.

tools.name: mockup-get
tools.description: Get a single mockup by its ID, including image URL, prompt, and metadata.

tools.name: mockup-list
tools.description: List mockups created by the authenticated user. Supports pagination.

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

tools.name: mockup-presets
tools.description: Browse proven scene descriptions (presets) by category. Returns prompt templates you can use directly as the prompt parameter in mockup-generate. These are NOT image references — they are scene descriptions.

tools.name: mockup-update

tools.name: psd-mockup-produce
tools.description:
End-to-end PSD mockup production: optionally generate the artwork, then place it into a real PSD template and publish the final image. The single tool an agent needs to deliver a finished mockup.

Pipeline:
1. Provide artPrompt (to generate art) OR artUrl (existing artwork). With brandGuidelineId, the brand logo/colors/typography are auto-injected into generation.
2. The art is placed into the template's smart object (cover mode) via the scene fast path (falls back to opening the PSD automatically).
3. Returns the published imageUrl.

Costs: generating art with artPrompt costs credits (same as mockup-generate); the render itself is free. If render fails after generation, the generation credits are refunded. Passing artUrl costs nothing.

Pick the template with psd-scene-list first and match the art aspect ratio to the face's suggestedAspectRatio.

psdFileName.description: Bare PSD file name from psd-scene-list (e.g. "HM_BANNER_002.psd"). No paths.

artPrompt.description: Prompt to GENERATE the artwork that goes into the smart object. Describe the DESIGN to place (poster/label/screen content). Mutually exclusive with artUrl. Costs credits.

artUrl.description: URL of existing artwork to place. Skips generation (free). Use artPrompt OR artUrl.

brandGuidelineId.description: Brand guideline ID — injects logo/colors/typography when generating art (artPrompt path).

face.description: Target smart object name/key from psd-scene-list. Omit to apply to all editable faces.

model.description: Image model for the artPrompt path. Default is recommended.

preview.description: true = fast low-res JPEG preview; false = full-res PNG.

tools.name: psd-scene-list
tools.description:
List the PSD mockup Scene Package catalog (pre-processed templates ready for instant rendering).

Each scene has FACES (smart objects where art is placed). For each face you get innerW/innerH — the pixel size of the editable area. The ideal art aspect ratio = innerW/innerH, and art is applied in COVER mode (it fills the face and the overflow is cropped), so keep the important content centered.

Workflow: pick a scene + face by brand/brief, then call psd-mockup-produce with that psdFileName (and face if the scene has multiple). If a PSD from the Drive catalog has no scene yet, run psd-scene-prepare first.

search.description: Case-insensitive filter on the PSD file name (client-side).

tools.name: psd-scene-prepare
tools.description: Pre-process a PSD from the Drive catalog into a Scene Package so it can be rendered instantly. Use this ONCE when a template you want is not yet in psd-scene-list. Heavy operation (opens the PSD), but cached forever after. Returns the extracted faces.

psdFileName.description: Bare PSD file name from the Drive catalog (e.g. "HM_BANNER_002.psd"). No paths.
